display_long_description:
Flight Simulator New York puts you in the captain's seat over the real New York.

THE REAL NEW YORK
Built from real aerial photography and real map data: the Empire State Building, the Chrysler Building's crown and One World Trade Center, Central Park in autumn colours, the Statue of Liberty, Times Square, the USS Intrepid, the Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queensboro, George Washington and Verrazzano bridges, the Hudson, the East River and the harbour. Four airports: JFK, LaGuardia, Newark and Teterboro.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your own glass hangar on the Brooklyn waterfront, Lower Manhattan across the river at golden hour. Walk around your aircraft, repaint them, power wash them clean, then choose one and fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with glass cockpits, side-sticks and walk-through cabins, a cozy midsize jet with yokes and a club cabin, and a twin-engine supersonic fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: landings at JFK and LaGuardia, a sunset hop to Newark, the Hudson River corridor, a skyline run up the East River, a harbour run past the Statue, a fighter scramble, a night run over Midtown and a New York tour - or just fly, by day, at sunset or at night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Join up on a friend's wing or ride in their aircraft. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
